description: This file defines the AuditService class that facilitates recording and querying audit events within a software system. It includes methods for inserting audit event records into a database and retrieving them based on filtering criteria.

classes.name: AuditService
classes.description: Service for managing audit trails with transactional behavior, capable of recording audit events and querying them from the database.

methods.description: Records an audit event with relevant details such as event type, entity info, actor info, result, and optional details, returning the generated audit event ID.

methods.name: list query_events( self, entity_type: Optional[str] = None, entity_id: Optional[str] = None, limit: int = 100 )
methods.description: Queries audit events from the database with optional filtering by entity type and ID, returning a list of matching events.
